fields.summary_ko.0: Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) has market capitalization of approximately $5.3 trillion as the world's largest company, with Q2 revenue reaching $96.2 billion, up 106% year-over-year, and net income of $59.7 billion, up 32%
fields.summary_ko.1: Data center segment represents over 90% of Nvidia revenue, creating substantial exposure to AI market weakness, and departure from diversified business portfolio of past years represents key risk factor with lack of business diversification
fields.summary_ko.2: Goldman Sachs analysts forecast 2026 AI-related capital expenditures by tech companies will exceed $1 trillion, with Nvidia's new Vera Rubin platform specialized for agentic AI workload processing
